headline: Expansive coastal district with low density, affordable housing, and developing road infrastructure

tags.reason: The affordability index is 83 out of 100, with new flats averaging 1,522 AZN/m² compared to the Baku median of 2,295 AZN/m².
The education index stands at 82 out of 100, supported by 6.08 schools and 4.73 kindergartens per 10,000 residents.

summary: Qaradağ covers 1,095.9 km² with a low population density of 110 people per km², well below the Baku median of 2,890.5. The district presents high housing affordability (index 83 versus median 50), with old flats listed at 1,500 AZN/m² against a city-wide median of 2,084 AZN/m². However, transport connectivity is constrained with zero metro stations, a nearest metro distance of 27 km, and an infrastructure index of 10 out of 100. Paved roads account for only 36.7% of known surfaces compared to the Baku median of 83.1%.
strengths: High concentration of educational facilities (6.08 schools per 10,000 residents; median 3.43)
Significant healthcare provision (3.72 hospitals per 10,000 residents; median 2.75)
Accessible park space across large territory (20.27 parks per 10,000 residents; median 10.04)
weaknesses: Low paved road share among known surfaces (36.7% paved; median 83.1%)
Substantial distance to rapid transit network (nearest metro station 27 km; 0 metro stations)
Higher modelled particulate air pollution (PM2.5 model 14.2; median 12.8)
best_for: Buyers prioritising lower property acquisition costs (new flats 1,522 AZN/m²; Baku median 2,295 AZN/m²)
Households seeking proximity to primary education (6.08 schools per 10,000 residents; median 3.43)
watch_out: Road quality data gaps, as 48.1% of road surfaces in the district remain unknown in OpenStreetMap records
Title extract documentation, with 74% of 223 listings having a çıxarış (title extract), meaning 26% lack registered extracts
Long commuting distances to central hubs due to 0 metro stations and reliance on 11 bus routes across 1,095.9 km²
confidence_note: OpenStreetMap coverage is high and per capita metrics are reliable, but land price (9,000 AZN/sot) is a mock value and must be disregarded. Apartment and house pricing are based on a sample of 223 listings from October–November 2024.
